Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

mighty.metadata 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.
  • Core classes: mighty_domain() for single ADaM datasets and mighty_study() for full studies.
  • Column, parameter, and row manipulation verbs: list_*(), add_*(), remove_*(), update_*(), select_*(), move_*().
  • Study-level operations: populate_core(), populate_sparse(), and resolve_includes().

Developed by Aksel Thomsen, Ari Siggaard Knoph, Matthew Phelps, Giulia Pais.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.0.
